meta_description: Review the items currently in your OpenDrone cart.
title: Your cart
description: Review your selected hardware before heading to checkout.
error_coming_soon_all: This product is coming soon and not orderable yet. Join the launch list on the product page instead.
warning_coming_soon_some: Some items are coming soon and were not added to the cart.
note_preorder: This order contains pre-order items. Each shows its ship date, which is also stated at checkout and on your order confirmation. You pay the full price now, and the whole order ships in one parcel once every item in it is ready. If a funding target is missed, the rest of the order ships without waiting for it. [How preorders work](/preorder)
note_vat: Prices include VAT. Shipping for the selected country is in the estimated total above; checkout confirms it for your address. Any discount code is applied on the next page.
note_terms: By completing this order you accept the Incutec [End-Use Policy](/en/end-use) and the [General Terms and Conditions](/en/algemene-voorwaarden).
ballot_hint: Rank up to three projects you want us to build next. Your ranking is saved with this order at checkout.
ballot_empty: Optional. Tap to rank; change it any time before checkout.
note_us: Shipping to the United States is €19.95 per order, included in the estimated total above. We do not collect US import duties at checkout: the carrier collects them from you before delivery. US import duty on electronics and motors made in China is high, often around 35 to 40% of the value; US customs sets the amount. [Shipping](/en/shipping)
note_intl: Shipping for the selected country is a flat rate per order, included in the estimated total above; checkout confirms it for your address. We do not collect import duties at checkout: the carrier may collect import duties and taxes from you on delivery. [Shipping](/en/shipping)
mixed_title: Your items ship on different dates.
mixed_body: The whole order ships in one parcel once the last item is ready. If a funding target in it is missed, the rest of the order ships without waiting for it.
mixed_targets_title: Your order waits for more than one funding target.
mixed_targets_body: The whole order ships in one parcel once every target is reached, about 10 weeks after the last one. If a target is not reached by 31 December 2026, you choose a refund for that item or to keep waiting (no reply within 30 days means a refund), and the rest of the order ships without waiting for it.
